trigger.Name: GlobalVar
trigger.script: -- println("Map Region 4 map 2: Initialised") SetVar("CountArmyKill",0) local test=0 if test==1 then -- println("TESTING: MAP DON'T WORK CORRECT WITH ANOTHER MAPS ") CompleteQuest("r4m1_RescueBuharsCivilian") TakeQuest("r4m1_GotoAivenGo") end SetVar("PlayerExitVeh", 0) trigger:Deactivate()

trigger.Name: StartMapAndCheck
trigger.script: local diff = GetDifficultyLevel() if diff == 0 then RuleConsole("/ai_clash_coeff 0.000015") RuleConsole("/ai_player_weapons_damage_coeff 1.5") RuleConsole("/ai_enemies_ramming_damage_coeff 2") RuleConsole("/ai_min_hit_velocity 30") elseif diff == 1 then RuleConsole("/ai_clash_coeff 0.000015") RuleConsole("/ai_player_weapons_damage_coeff 1") RuleConsole("/ai_enemies_ramming_damage_coeff 1") RuleConsole("/ai_min_hit_velocity 30") elseif diff == 2 then RuleConsole("/ai_clash_coeff 0.003") RuleConsole("/ai_player_weapons_damage_coeff 0.75") RuleConsole("/ai_enemies_ramming_damage_coeff 1") RuleConsole("/ai_min_hit_velocity 30") end

trigger.Name: trStartMap
trigger.script:
if QuestStatus("r4m2_FightWithCrazy")==Q_CANBEGIVEN then TActivate("trMoveToFatherCar") TActivate("trMoveToMilitaryBase") TActivate("trNearBase")
CreateNewDummyObject( "mirotvorecCargo05", "mirCargo", -1, -1, CVector(1554.298, 329.958, 338.369), Quaternion(-0.0383, 0.7107, 0.0388, 0.7014), 8) CreateNewDummyObject( "mirotvorecCab05", "mirCab", -1, -1, CVector(1559.402, 329.696, 338.649), Quaternion(0.0278, 0.7066, -0.0278, 0.7066), 8)
local Acab = GetEntityByName("mirCab") if Acab then Acab:SetBelong(1042) end
local Acargo = GetEntityByName("mirCargo") if Acargo then Acargo:SetBelong(1042) end
trigger:Deactivate() end

trigger.Name: trMoveToFatherCar
trigger.script:
-- println("Father Car")
SaveAllToleranceStatus(RS_NEUTRAL)
local Plf = GetPlayerVehicle() Plf:SetCustomControlEnabled( true ) Plf:SetCustomLinearVelocity( 0 ) Plf:SetThrottle( 0 ) Plf:SetCustomControlEnabled( false )
Fly("FatherCar_Cam", CINEMATIC_NO_AIM, 0, 28, 1, 1 ) StartCinematic()
AddCinematicMessage( 201, 0.25 ) AddCinematicMessage( 202, 0.25 ) AddCinematicMessage( 203, 0.25 ) AddCinematicMessage( 204, 0.25 )
TActivate("trMoveToFatherCar_End")
trigger:Deactivate()

trigger.Name: trMoveToFatherCar_End
trigger.script:
RestoreAllToleranceStatus()
SetCameraBehindPlayerVehicle()
AddPlayerMoney(20000) AddHistory( "r4_FindFatherCar" ) AddFadingMsgId( "fm_history_got" ) trigger:Deactivate()

trigger.Name: trNearBase
trigger.script: -- println("Near Base") TakeQuest("r4m2_FightWithCrazy") TActivate("cinNearBase") trigger:Deactivate()

trigger.Name: trMoveToMilitaryBase
trigger.script: -- println("Military Base") if QuestStatus("r4m2_FightWithCrazy")==Q_CANBEGIVEN then TActivate("trActivateArmyDie") CompleteQuest("r4m1_FindMilitaryBase") trigger:Deactivate() end

trigger.Name: trMBArmy01Die
trigger.script: TActivate("trActivateArmyDie") trigger:Deactivate()

trigger.Name: trActivateArmyDie
trigger.script: local count = GetVar("CountArmyKill").AsInt if count>=6 then TActivate("trHelpers1") TDeactivate("trMBArmy01Die") else for i = 1,4 do if getObj("MBArmy0"..i)==nil then count = count + 1 local vehlist={"Tank01","Hunter01","Hunter02","Cruiser01","Cruiser02","UralShot","HunterKamikaze"} local veh1=vehlist[random(getn(vehlist))] local veh2=vehlist[random(getn(vehlist))] CreateTeam("MBArmy0"..i, 1062, CVector(getPos("SpawnCrazy"..random(17).."_loc")),{veh1,veh2},CVector(getPos("MilitaryBase_loc"))) end end TActivate("trMBArmy01Die") SetVar("CountArmyKill", count) end trigger:Deactivate()

trigger.Name: trHelpers1
trigger.script: -- println("Helpers1") TActivate("cinHelpersFirst") trigger:Deactivate()

trigger.Name: trNearPlate
trigger.script:
-- println("trNearPlate")
TActivate("cinLookToTarelkaFirst")
AddHistory( "r4_NearTarelka" ) -- AddHistory( "r4_AfterTarelka" ) AddFadingMsgId( "fm_history_got" ) CompleteQuest("r4m2_InvestigationPlate") trigger:Deactivate()

trigger.Name: trMoveToPlate
trigger.script: -- println("PLATE") if GetVar("PlayerExitVeh").AsInt == 1 then AddPlayerMoney(GetVar("money").AsInt) SetVar("PlayerExitVeh", 0) local plcarname=GetVar("PlayerCarName").AsString local veh=getObj(plcarname) GetPlayerVehicle():SetNameFromScript("PlayerHuman") CapturePlayerVehicle() getObj("PlayerHuman"):Remove() g_Player:AddChild(veh) GetPlayerVehicle():setGodMode(0) GetPlayerVehicle():SetCustomControlEnabled(0) TDeactivate("trPlayerReturnVehicleDist") TActivate("trExitToR4M1") RestoreWeaponGroups() AllowSave( true ) end TActivate("cinPlateFirst") trigger:Deactivate()

trigger.Name: trExitToR4M1
trigger.script:
GetPlayerVehicle():SetCustomLinearVelocity( 0 ) local b = SpawnMessageBox( "8801" )
if b == 1 then -- println ("Yes") PassToMap("r4m1", "FromR4M2", -1) else -- println ("No") TActivate("cinExit41ReturnFirst") end

trigger.Name: trExitFromCity
trigger.script: TActivate("cinAfterTalkScienfFirst") trigger:Deactivate()

trigger.script: TActivate("DestroyBase") trigger:Deactivate()

trigger.Name: DestroyBase
trigger.script: CreateTeam("BaseFighter1",1062,CVector(2357.583, 297.712, 1188.729),{"Tank01","BelazShot","UralShot","CruiserShot","Tank01"}, nil, Quaternion(0.000, 0.340, 0.002, 0.941)) CreateTeam("BaseFighter2",1062,CVector(2303.711, 297.356, 1187.997),{"Dozer01","BelazShot","Hunter02Menu","MirotvorecShot","Tank01"}, nil, Quaternion(-0.000, -0.898, -0.000, 0.439)) CreateTeam("BaseFighter3",1062,CVector(2339.106, 297.483, 1078.573),{"Tank01","Hunter01","UralShot","zil130_test","Tank01"}, nil, Quaternion(-0.005, -0.459, -0.010, -0.888)) TActivate("KillCounterDestroyBase") trigger:Deactivate()

trigger.Name: KillCounterDestroyBase
trigger.script: trigger:IncCount() local count = trigger:GetCount() if 3>count then return end CompleteQuest("quest309") TakeQuest("quest310") trigger:Deactivate()

trigger.Name: trPlayerExitVehicle
trigger.script: if GetVar("PlayerExitVeh").AsInt == 0 and IsQuestComplete("NewGame") then SetVar("money", GetPlayerMoney()) g_Player:AddMoney(-999999999) local pospl = GetPlayerVehicle():GetPosition() local rotpl = GetPlayerVehicle():GetRotation(Quaternion()) local coord = GetPlayerVehicle():GetPosition() SetVar("PlayerExitVeh", 1) -- SetVar("PlayerCarName",GetPlayerVehicle():GetName()) GetPlayerVehicle():SetCustomLinearVelocity( 0 ) GetPlayerVehicle():SetThrottle( 0 ) if getObj("OldPlayerCar") then local i = random(1,10000) getObj("OldPlayerCar"):SetNameFromScript("OldPlayerCar0"..i) end GetPlayerVehicle():SetNameFromScript("OldPlayerCar") CapturePlayerVehicle() getObj("OldPlayerCar"):setGodMode(0) getObj("OldPlayerCar"):SetCustomControlEnabled(0) getObj("OldPlayerCar"):SetBelong(1080) -- local plcarname=GetVar("PlayerCarName").AsString -- local veh=getObj(plcarname) -- veh:setGodMode(0) -- veh:SetBelong(1080) AddPlayerVehicle("Human01") GetPlayerVehicle():SetNameFromScript("PlayerHuman") GetPlayerVehicle():SetBelong(1080) TActivate("LocPlayerlll") TDeactivate("triggerExitToMap11") TDeactivate("triggerExitToMap13") AllowSave( false ) GetPlayerVehicle():SetGamePositionOnGround( CVector(pospl)) coord.x = coord.x + 5 coord.y = coord.y + 0 coord.z = coord.z + 5 GetPlayerVehicle():SetGamePositionOnGround(CVector(coord)) GetPlayerVehicle():SetRotation(Quaternion(rotpl)) TDeactivate("PlayerEnterCar") end trigger:Deactivate()

trigger.Name: LocPlayerlll
trigger.script: if GetVar("PlayerExitVeh").AsInt == 1 then local coord = GetPlayerVehicle():GetPosition() coord.x = coord.x + 4 coord.y = coord.y + 0 coord.z = coord.z + 4 getObj("player_veh_loc1"):SetPosition(CVector(coord)) coord.x = coord.x - 8 coord.y = coord.y + 0 coord.z = coord.z - 8 getObj("player_veh_loc2"):SetPosition(CVector(coord)) coord.x = coord.x - 0 coord.y = coord.y + 0 coord.z = coord.z + 8 getObj("player_veh_loc3"):SetPosition(CVector(coord)) coord.x = coord.x + 8 coord.y = coord.y + 0 coord.z = coord.z - 8 getObj("player_veh_loc4"):SetPosition(CVector(coord)) else trigger:Deactivate() end

trigger.Name: CarEnterLoc
trigger.script:
CarId = GetEntityByID(trigger:GetTriggeredObjectID(0)) local PlayerId = GetPlayerVehicle() CaridBelong = CarId:GetBelong()
println(PlayerId) println(CarId)
if CarId == PlayerId then getObj("player_veh_loc1"):SetPosition(CVector(20,0,20)) getObj("player_veh_loc2"):SetPosition(CVector(20,0,20)) getObj("player_veh_loc3"):SetPosition(CVector(20,0,20)) getObj("player_veh_loc4"):SetPosition(CVector(20,0,20)) println("Player cannot enter the car because he is alone in the location.") TDeactivate("CarLeaveLoc") SetVar("PlayerWithCar", 0) else TActivate("CarLeaveLoc") SetVar("PlayerWithCar", 1) AddImportantFadingMsgByStrIdFormatted("fm_entervehtrue_1") trigger:Deactivate() end

trigger.Name: CarLeaveLoc
trigger.script: TActivate("CarEnterLoc") SetVar("PlayerWithCar", 0) AddImportantFadingMsgByStrIdFormatted("fm_entervehfalse_1") trigger:Deactivate()

trigger.Name: PlayerEnterCar
trigger.script:
if GetVar("PlayerExitVeh").AsInt == 1 and GetVar("PlayerWithCar").AsInt == 1 and CarId:IsAlive() then AllowSave( true ) GetPlayerVehicle():SetNameFromScript("PlayerHuman") CapturePlayerVehicle() getObj("PlayerHuman"):Remove() g_Player:AddChild(CarId)
SetVar("PlayerWithCar", 0) SetVar("PlayerExitVeh", 0)
TActivate("CarEnterLoc") TActivate("LocPlayerlll")
GetPlayerVehicle():setGodMode(0) GetPlayerVehicle():SetCustomControlEnabled(0) GetPlayerVehicle():SetBelong(CaridBelong) GetPlayerVehicle():SetCustomControlEnabled(0) GetPlayerVehicle():SetExternalPathByName("")
TActivate("triggerExitToMap11") TActivate("triggerExitToMap13") TDeactivate("trPlayerExitVehicle") getObj("player_veh_loc1"):SetPosition(CVector(20,0,20)) getObj("player_veh_loc2"):SetPosition(CVector(20,0,20)) getObj("player_veh_loc3"):SetPosition(CVector(20,0,20)) getObj("player_veh_loc4"):SetPosition(CVector(20,0,20)) g_Player:AddMoney(GetVar("money").AsInt) if GetPlayerVehicle():GetBelong() == 1080 then GetPlayerVehicle():SetBelong("1100") end end
trigger:Deactivate()
